title: Postscript

interpretation_guidance.instruction: Take what I say here as literally as you possibly can

safety_rules.dangerous_places: None of five treasure boxes hidden in dangerous place
safety_rules.not_perilous: Not hazardous to arrive at any box
safety_rules.water: No box hidden under any body of water
safety_rules.no_water_vessel_needed: No need for raft, canoe, or water vessel of any kind
safety_rules.no_swift_current: No box precariously close to swift current
safety_rules.no_cliff_scaling: No need to scale cliff or rock face
safety_rules.no_winter_snow: Do not search in winter in areas where there is bitter cold and snow - will be impossible to find boxes if blanket of snow covering ground
safety_rules.distance_from_road: No treasure hidden more than THREE MILES from any road
safety_rules.private_property: Avoid going on private property - this is a strict rule
safety_rules.no_private_property_boxes: No box is hidden on private property of any kind
safety_rules.no_walking_through_private: No need to walk through private property to arrive at location of any box
safety_rules.exception: Only exception would be rare case where public trail crosses private land for short ways and that section has been given public easement
safety_rules.no_digging: No need to dig up or disturb public lands
safety_rules.not_buried: No treasure box is buried under the ground on public lands
safety_rules.digging_wont_help: Digging will not help you find any of our treasures

hunting_safety.hunting_seasons: If on land where hunting is allowed, make yourself aware of hunting seasons and always dress in bright clothes
hunting_safety.companion: Search with friend or loved one - more fun and safer
hunting_safety.phone: Wise to always bring a phone
hunting_safety.know_location: Make sure you always know your location and how to get back
hunting_safety.wildlife: Research wildlife in area - if bears are known to be local carry bear spray and have practiced how to use it; be aware of poisonous snakes and other potentially dangerous wildlife, such as buffaloes, moose, or even elk during mating season

people_interactions.no_insider_knowledge: Author did not give anyone clues to where he hid any boxes
people_interactions.no_family_knowledge: Wife, children, parents, siblings - none privy to any proprietary information
people_interactions.no_mentioned_people_know: If you happen to cross paths with any of these wonderful people, do not ask them questions - they can't help you, even if they tried

final_message.purpose: This postscript is not meant to discourage, dissuade, or frighten you
final_message.intent: Hunting for our treasures should be fun, invigorating, scenic, and pleasurable
final_message.confidence: Each treasure box is well within your ability to safely retrieve
final_message.wish: At the end of this hunt, that is all I wish for you

CRITICAL_RULES: All within 3 miles of a road
Take postscript LITERALLY - no hidden meanings here
